props.description: The date: a `Date`, or an ISO 8601 string as an API sends it. An invalid date draws nothing.
props.name: date

props.description:
What the date means; `date` (the default) shows no state, `due` can be due soon or overdue, `expiry` can be
expiring soon or expired.
props.name: kind

props.description: How many days ahead a due date or expiry counts as soon; defaults to 3. A market pack can change it.
props.name: soonDays

props.description:
True (the default) to write a date within a week as "tomorrow" or "3 days ago"; the full date is always read
out and shown on hover.
props.name: isRelative

props.description: The calendar the full date is written in; defaults to `gregory`.
props.name: calendar

props.description: "Now", for a fixed point in a test or a demo; defaults to the moment the label mounted.
props.name: now

props.description: False to skip the single attention pulse an overdue or expired label plays when it appears.
props.name: isAnimated

props.description: The emphasis of the chip: filled, neutral, transparent or tinted. Defaults to `secondary`.
props.name: variant

props.description: An element drawn before the text, on the inline-start side: an icon name or any icon element, sized to the text.
props.name: startIcon

props.description: An element drawn after the text, on the inline-end side: an icon name or any icon element, sized to the text.
props.name: endIcon

props.description:
Animation configuration for chip
- `"disable-all"`: Disable all animations including children
- `undefined`: Use default animations
props.name: animation

props.description:
Background layer rendered behind the chip surface.
- `undefined` (default): renders `Chip.Background` for the combinations
  whose background uses the default color (secondary variant, or
  primary / soft variants with `color="default"`) when the active
  library theme registers default background content (e.g. `glass`);
  otherwise no layer
- custom node: replaces the default layer entirely (wrap content in
  `Chip.Background` to keep the absolute-fill and clipping)
- `null`: removes the background layer
props.name: background

props.description: Custom class name for the chip
props.name: className

props.description: Used to reference react managed views from native code.
props.name: id

props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
props.name: ref

props.description:
Either view styles or a function that receives a boolean reflecting whether
the component is currently pressed and returns view styles.
props.name: style

props.description: Used to locate this view in end-to-end tests.
props.name: testID
